decisions.reason: The source change concerns the formatting and detail level of result-driver explanations, not the score panel, result fields, heading, or result prominence.
The confidential distribution warning is an independent final-page element and is unaffected by simplifying front-page result drivers.
The vehicle identification display remains valid unchanged; the source modification only changes the presentation of the result-driver section.
Allowing longer explanation elsewhere in the report does not necessarily change internal-page header coverage, content, or presentation.
The concise bullet treatment is a local content-presentation change and does not alter the retained cross-variant visual theme or general design direction.
Changing the result-driver section to concise bullets does not alter which customer-specific fields must be editable or their editing behavior.
The DX-17 header identifier remains unchanged and is independent of the front-page result-driver format.
The candidate governs assessment-date placeholder copy; the source change neither modifies that policy nor necessarily establishes new approved core copy elsewhere.
The source modification does not change footer presence or footer content; the client separately states that the footer works well.
The DX17–DX20 variant set, editability, and selection basis remain unchanged by the result-driver formatting refinement.
The transparent scoring table is distinct from the front-page explanation of what caused the result, so its format and required fields remain unchanged.
The requested bullet-based result-driver presentation does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset package.
